tasks.label: Build & Install x64-Debug
tasks.command: if [ ! -d out/build/x64-Debug ]; then cmake -S . -B out/build/x64-Debug -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug; fi && cmake --build out/build/x64-Debug && cmake --install out/build/x64-Debug --prefix out/install/x64-Debug

windows.command: "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" amd64 && cmake --build out/build/x64-Debug && cmake --install out/build/x64-Debug --prefix out/install/x64-Debug

tasks.label: Build & Install x64-Release
tasks.command: if [ ! -d out/build/x64-Release ]; then cmake -S . -B out/build/x64-Release -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo; fi && cmake --build out/build/x64-Release && cmake --install out/build/x64-Release --prefix out/install/x64-Release

windows.command: "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" amd64 && cmake --build out/build/x64-Release && cmake --install out/build/x64-Release --prefix out/install/x64-Release
